In the latest Economist/YouGov survey, Trump is exiting August with a 33 percent approval rating, a new low for him in that poll.

Trump’s polling in the Decision Desk HQ (DDHQ) average did see a slight increase Thursday, reaching 39.2 percent.

Still, this average marked the second-lowest released by DDHQ since May, when Trump averaged 38 percent. The polling average also found that 57.5 percent disapproved of the president. [...] Trump’s numbers are lower than they were in his first term.

A new Economist/YouGov poll, released Aug. 11, found that 33% of Americans approve of Trump's job performance, down 3 percentage points from the previous week. This marks the lowest approval rating the president has received in YouGov tracking since returning to office in 2025. [...] The Economist/YouGov poll also found that 60% of Americans view the president as "not honest and trustworthy." Trump's age continues to concern many Americans, with 53% saying they believe the 80-year-old president is too old to serve in the White House. Additionally, 69% said they feel that things in the country are "out of control." [...] ### Rasmussen
